chapter_labels_number_differs: Chapter {chapter}: {text} (the number is not this chapter's)
chapter_labels_none: No book in this project has chapter labels.
chapter_labels_done: {count, plural, one {Chapter labels standardized in # book} other {Chapter labels standardized in # books}}
chapter_labels_nothing: Every chosen book already reads that way
chapter_labels_stale: A book changed while this was open; open Chapter labels again
chapter_labels_mark_word: “{word}” differs from the other chapter labels (“{expected}”)
chapter_labels_summary: {count, plural, one {# chapter label reads differently} other {# chapter labels read differently}} ({words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} in {books, plural, one {# book} other {# books}})
import_document_found: {verses, plural, one {# verse} other {# verses}} in {chapters, plural, one {# chapter} other {# chapters}}
import_document_choose_book: Choose the book to import into
import_document_keep: Try to keep this book's paragraphing
import_document_keep_tip: Keeps the paragraph markers where they were, wherever that can be determined.
import_document_keep_front_tip: The book's title, headers and table of contents stay as they are, and the document's text before chapter 1 is left out. Off, that text replaces them, under the book's own \id line.
import_document_poetry_tip: Indented, wholly italic, Quote-styled or short hand-broken lines become poetry lines (\q1–\q3, by indent). Off, they stay ordinary paragraphs.
import_document_headings_tip: Heading styles, and short bold or centred lines with no verse, become section headings (\s1). Off, they are kept as \rem notes.
import_document_front_tip: Text the document has before its first verse, such as a title, kept as \rem notes. Off, it is left out. While this book's front matter is kept, any of it before chapter 1 is left out either way.
import_document_notes_tip: The document's footnotes and endnotes become USFM footnotes (\f). Off, they are left out.
import_document_italic_tip: Italic spans are marked italic (\it). Off, they are plain text.
import_document_bold_tip: Bold spans are marked bold (\bd). Off, they are plain text.
import_document_lists_tip: Numbered and bulleted paragraphs become list items (\li1). Off, they stay ordinary paragraphs.
import_document_style_markers_tip: Paragraph styles named after a USFM marker (a style called “q2”) become that marker. Off, the style name is ignored.
import_document_mode_line_start: At the start of a line
import_document_chapter_words_tip: A line that is one of these words and a number, like “Chapter 3”, starts that chapter and is left out. A chapter also starts where verse 1 comes again.
import_document_tracked: {count, plural, one {# tracked change is} other {# tracked changes are}} still in the file, and imported as accepted
import_document_skipped: {count, plural, one {# number that looked like a verse was} other {# numbers that looked like verses were}} left as text
import_document_nothing: The document holds no chapters in this range
import_document_lost: Removed, because the document does not have them: {verses}
import_document_absent: Not in the document, left as they are: chapters {chapters}
import_document_front_skipped: The document's text before chapter 1 is left out; the book keeps its own header
import_document_labels_kept: The book's chapter labels are kept where the document has none: chapters {chapters}
